forum.title: [STM32H563] [STM32CubeMx] Unable to enable PTP
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello all,

This issue has been fixed in the latest version of STM32CubeMX 6.18.0

Download STM32CubeMX6.18.0 from [this link.](https://www.st.com/en/development-tools/stm32cubemx.html)

Regards,

Souhaib
forum.content_text:
Hello,

For one of my project, my goal is to use PTP to synchronise multiple STM32H563 to one host.

However, when configuring the ETH Device, I can only enable RMII, as the "RMII\_PTP\_SYNCHRO" is greyed out.

I've read the pop up that tells me to enable TIM2 as a slave with trigger source "ETR1 through Remap", Channel 1 as "Input Capture direct mode from Remap".

And both "remap capabilities" are set to "is connected to ETH\_PPS".

Is there something that I'm missing ?

Best regards
forum.author: AMouton

scraped_replies.html:
Hello @AMouton 

Thanks for highlighting this behavior,

I will check it internally and get back to you ASAP.

KR, Souhaib
scraped_replies.author: Souhaib MAZHOUD

scraped_replies.html:
Hello @Souhaib MAZHOUD !
If that can help you, I'm running CubeMX 6.17.0 (and I've tried with older versions too)

I've looked through the STM32H5 & STM32H7 examples and never found an example where RMII_PTP_SYNCHRO is enabled. I believe the check condition for where the option is available is problematic on all STM32Hx models.

Is there any way I can help you or your team to troubleshoot this ?

Regards,
Albin Mouton
